nom: Prequel Skin Universal Skin Solution Hypochlorous Acid Spray for Face and Body. Fine Mist HOCL Facial Cleanser and Derma

segments.oily: A reviewer using the spray on oily areas of her back and chest reports it helps keep minor acne away and leaves a glowy look.
segments.dry: A reviewer with very dry and sensitive skin who had struggled with allergy-related rashes for 15 years despite prescriptions reports this is the first thing that calmed her skin drastically.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including several with rosacea, eczema or a history of perioral dermatitis, report reduced redness and irritation with no stinging; one reviewer with rosacea-related redness, however, reports the spray caused new breakouts and more redness than she had before using it.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the spray as hydrating, refreshing and non-greasy; one reviewer notes it can be a little drying with frequent use and recommends moisturizing afterward.
concerns.redness: The large majority of reviewers, many with rosacea, report a noticeable reduction in redness over one to two weeks of daily use; one reviewer, however, reports it caused more redness than she had before using it.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports the spray helps keep her skin barrier balanced, especially during stressful periods or sudden weather changes; a lifelong eczema sufferer separately reports it calms her reactive skin when used alongside a moisturizing balm.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including some managing perioral dermatitis, post-procedure irritation or retinoid purging, report the spray calms breakouts faster than usual; one reviewer, however, reports it caused new pimples that she did not have before using it.

aspects.libelle: Chlorine or bleach-like scent takes getting used to
Fine, lightweight mist that absorbs without residue
Frequently arrives damaged, leaking or missing its safety seal
Good value compared to similar sprays like Tower 28
Doubles as a deodorant and for minor skin irritations beyond the face

extraits.texte: Has a mild mildew and chlorine water smell. I really tried to give it a chance. I even let it refill the subscription, but it is actually causing breakouts and more redness on my face that I didn’t have beforehand. I have redness from rosacea but now I’ve got breakouts like actual pimples something’s not right with this product. At least it’s not right for me.

extraits.titre: The Best Dermal Spray I Have Found So Far
extraits.texte: This is the best lotion I have found to calm my reactive skin. I have had eczema my whole life. I use this spray before applying the highly moisturizing Aveeno Eczema Therapy Nighttime Itch Relief Balm on my extremities and back. This spray helps calm my skin. I use it after my morning shower. It is not the end all of skin treatments, but it seems to be as helpful as prescription strength steroid cream. For a great eczema treatment,a soak in a hyper-salinic solution for 20 minutes will clear up much eczema if repeated for three days in a row. To make the hyper-salinic solution in your bath, pour table salt , ice cream salt, or kosher salt in the bottom of your tub until no more will go into solution. That means there will still be salt on the bottom of the tub. You may rinse off in the shower after the soak. A soak in the Dead Sea in Israel is even better. However, that is a long trip. If you happen to travel to Israel, take advantage of the Dead Sea soak. I recommend this dermal spray to help alleviate itching.

extraits.titre: Helping the redness, at least somewhat
extraits.texte: I have Type I rosacea, which means mostly I have redness and flushing. It has gotten better since I learned more about my skincare routine, and my rosacea. But there is still lingering redness and sometimes stinging if I'm not careful. This seems to be helping - while not completing erasing all the redness, I see a reduction. It took a couple of weeks - it isn't instantaneous, at least for me. It doesn't sting or burn going on. There is a slight 'chlorine or bleachy' scent but it's not bleach! It's very gentle. But do a patch test to be sure - always patch test. Can be a little drying so be sure to moisturize. And don't over-use it. I only do once a day and I don't spray much. I spray this on my clean dry skin and let it air dry. I don't use anything underneath it, not even toner, so I don't spray it in the mornings or evenings when I am using toners, serums/actives. This doesn't last long if you use it daily. Likely I'll start using it every other day and if my skin does okay, I'll continue with that. Absorbs quickly.

This is an excellent product! My dermatologist recommended I try a Hypochlorous Acid Spray to clear up the odor in my right armpit (I know, TMI) that I was struggling with. I saw Prequel recommended online and when I realized that it is Accepted by the National Rosacea Society (this label is on the container) I decided to try this one, as I have suffered from Rosacea in the past and was currently quite red on both sides of my face and hadn't had any luck with over the counter remedies. I like the size of the bottle and I am really impressed with the spritzer, it sprays a fine mist. It is very lightweight, and there is no tingling or stinging or scent when I sprayed it on my body anywhere. I spray this like deodorant on my armpits immediately after showering and drying off and it has done an excellent job of killing the bacteria that soap and water wouldn't wash off. I also decided to start spraying this on both sides of my face after washing and drying to see if it could help with my redness. I just let it dry and then add my deodorant or my makeup (depending on where I had sprayed it). One day after having used it for 1-2 weeks I looked in the mirror and I realized that the redness on both sides of my face had gotten better! It wasn't gone, but it was not as red!! I can't tell you how happy I was just for the reduction in redness! I also spray it on my upper back and chest to help with minor acne as well, since I have oily skin there. I’ve been using the Prequel Universal Skin Spray with Hypochlorous Acid for a few weeks now, and it has completely transformed my skincare routine. As someone with sensitive skin, I’m always cautious about introducing new products, but this spray has exceeded my expectations. First off, it’s hypoallergenic, which is a huge plus for me. I didn’t experience any irritation or redness, which is a common issue with other products. The formula is incredibly gentle yet effective, making it suitable for all skin types, including those with the most sensitive skin. What really impressed me was how versatile this spray is. I use it as a toner after cleansing, as a setting spray after applying makeup, and even to soothe any minor skin irritations or breakouts. It leaves my skin feeling refreshed, hydrated, and calm, without any sticky or greasy residue. Another bonus is the packaging – it’s sleek, easy to use, and perfect for on-the-go application. I love that I can carry it in my bag and spritz it anytime I need a quick refresh. For the price I cannot get enough! If you’re looking for a multi-purpose skincare product that delivers results, I highly recommend giving the Prequel Universal Skin Spray a try. It’s become a staple in my routine, and I can’t imagine my skincare regimen without it!

I have very dry and sensitive skin. I get rashes on face and body spring-summer due to my allergies. Have taken allergies shots, pills and ointments to help and honestly i was still miserable. Came across TikTok video of a girl saying it helped her rosacea ( i know not the same thing but i was desperate)not going to lie the smell of bleach is strong BUT it is the only thing that has helped my skin in 15 yrs. The second picture is about 24 hrs difference and usually by day 2 my rash even with prescription meds & ointments would be red and so itchy but no it really did calm my skin drastically. I even bought the travel size one from target to take with me on vacation, i tried it once after mosquito bite and it helped calm the itchiness. Will continue to buy.

extraits.titre: Lovely extra fine mist that soothes the skin
extraits.texte: I love the mist on this sprayer. It’s very fine and does not leave your skin super wet or with large droplets of product. It soaks right in and does not leave a film. Very easy to apply. I was recommended this to keep the bacterial load down on my face as I have been through 2 rounds of antibiotics for peri oral dermatitis.
